summary.intent: Execute Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) plans for Grafana alert rules and client timeout/retry tuning, then clean up the resulting code and fix a Grafana free tier cardinality limit.
summary.outcome: Phase 26 fully executed and verified (14/14 must-haves), code cleaned up, main branch merged, and two additional fixes shipped: Alloy metric filtering to drop unused Kubo/Someguy series and HTTP route cardinality capping to prevent unbounded label growth.

repo: The project uses a GSD (get-shit-done) workflow system with gsd-tools.cjs CLI for phase/plan management, stored under .planning/
The project runs on branch feat/phase-26-observability-ux-tuning against a cipher-box-ci-debug repo
Alloy (Grafana Agent) is used for metrics scraping via docker/alloy-config.river, scraping three targets: CipherBox API, Kubo (IPFS node at :5001), and Someguy (delegated routing at :8190)
Grafana Cloud Free tier has a 10,000 active series limit; Kubo alone can easily exceed this due to DHT, bitswap, libp2p, and Go runtime metrics

The staging dashboard (docker/grafana/dashboards/cipherbox-staging.json) only uses 6 external metrics from Kubo/Someguy: go_goroutines, go_memstats_alloc_bytes, libp2p_swarm_connections_opened/closed_total, libp2p_network_in/out_bytes_total
Alert rules only reference cipherbox_* metrics — no dependency on Kubo/Someguy metrics
Phase 26 was the last phase in milestone v1.1

code.finding: normalizeRoute fallback didn't catch random bot/scanner paths (e.g., /wp-admin, /.env), causing each unique 404 path to create 11 new histogram series. Fixed by collapsing unmatched routes to /:unmatched and removing normalizeRoute entirely since NestJS already parameterizes matched routes.
Added prometheus.relabel stage to filter Kubo/Someguy scrapes to only the 6 metrics actually used in dashboards, routing through filter before remote_write.
Timeout comments referenced ephemeral benchmark data (e.g., '~44x client-side pin p99 of 227ms') — removed in favor of intent-only comments.

Two sequential sed calls were combined into one with -e flags; delimiter changed from / to | to prevent breakage if UIDs contain forward slashes. --dry-run flag parsing scoped to ${@:4} to avoid collision with positional args.

workflow: When git diff main..HEAD shows 'removals' of features, check if main has moved ahead since branch creation — the diff may be showing inverse changes (branch missing commits from main PRs) rather than accidental deletions

Merging main into a feature branch can cause planning doc conflicts when both branches have updated ROADMAP.md/STATE.md; resolve by keeping the feature branch version (more recent phase state) but manually restoring completion marks for phases completed on main
GSD execute-phase init must be run from the correct working directory; running from the wrong repo silently returns 0 plans
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code bug can cause agents to report failure despite successful completion — spot-check SUMMARY.md existence and git commits before treating as real failure

friction: First execute-phase invocation failed with 'no plans found' because the GSD tools were inadvertently running against the wrong directory (cipher-box vs cipher-box-ci-debug)
plan-phase was called even though plans already existed — the workflow detected them and skipped re-planning, but the invocation was unnecessary

Merging main required manual conflict resolution of 3 planning docs (ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, REQUIREMENTS.md) and then manual restoration of Phase 24 and 25 completion marks that were lost during conflict resolution
git diff output was too large to read directly; required writing to a temp file and reading in chunks
open_items: Alert rule JSONs (~877 lines across 5 files) are structurally duplicated — a config table + template approach would significantly reduce this, but was deferred as out of scope
5s delegated routing timeout for delegated-ipfs.dev may be too aggressive under load — worth monitoring after deploy
ipHash: '' empty string fails strict 64-char hex validation somewhere in the codebase — flagged but not in Phase 26 scope

Desktop auto-updater removal, device registry v2→v1 downgrade, load test deletions, and recovery E2E deletion exist as pre-existing uncommitted changes on the branch (from 'carry forward' commits) — not Phase 26 work, needs attention separately
